In the Finnish Swedish language newspaper a letter from the Chairman of Nada Hope was published and it literally blows the SJW arguments about the current refugees out of the water.

Freely translated English version:

>The day when we close our borders has arrived. We’ve for a while now been allowed to observe how a continuously growing flow of so-called refugees make they way through Europe. This migration brings negative consequences with it and although I respect people no matter where they come from I still can see a looming catastrophe.

>For many years now I’ve been of the opinion that it’s unnecessary to polish the exterior of the EU with all kinds of ideas and one of the stupidest ideas has been open borders within the EU. It should be self evident that crime as an example increases if one has open borders. To have no borders is the same as having zero control. What annoys me the most is that there are many asylum seekers who’ve already applied for asylum in another EU country and have without any issues travelled within the EU and taken government aid from multiple countries.

>It’s an uncomfortable feeling to know about the negative aspects of open borders when one is neither a police officer or a “snitch”. Even before we got open borders within the EU I could foresee an increase in crime and because of that I’ve always been against open borders.

>During this autumn I’ve visited multiple asylum centres in Southern Finland and I’ve also met many newly arrived “refugees”. I’ve also discussed, talked and pondered. Finland and the whole EU is about to make a fatal mistake. Who thinks? Who understands? Who will say no? Is it only me?

>The great majority of the “refugees” that arrive here now do not fulfil the criteria of a refugee. Did you know that?

>Are the politicians afraid? Dare to speak out. You who hold the power. Don’t be such wimpy that you don’t dare to speak out. Close the borders and closely go through the clientele of these centres and we unfortunately need to accept basic facts. Those who fulfil the criteria of a refugee should of course be allowed to stay and those who don’t should be escorted back to their home countries.

>I don’t even dare to think about the bad news all of us in Europe will face if nobody dares to stand up and say no. It’s not a question about being racist, it’s about being honest and a realist. We can of course decide to not do anything and watch how the flow of people keeps on increasing.

>It is very important to talk about issues and to use the right terms when we do so. If we do that we’re talking about mass emigration and mass immigration. We’re not talking about refugees.

>Nytte Ekman

>Chairman, The Refugee Relief Organisation Nada Hope rf

Has Science Found Evidence Of An Advanced Alien Civilization? | IR.net

Probably. I'll give cliff notes of the actual science. Distant planets are basically impossible to see even with our most powerful telescopes. Yet we've been detecting hoards of them. How? It's a clever little 'trick'. What we do is we look at a star and look for periodic drops in its luminosity. A period and regular repeating drop in luminosity is indicative of something orbiting the star, likely a planet. Using a variety of other techniques we can then discern even more information about the object including distance form its star, size, density, likely temperature, etc. So these planetary orbits cause extremely small drops in luminosity. We're talking a fraction of a percent to one or two percent for an absolutely enormous planetoid.

We recently detected a behemoth 'something.' We're seeing something orbiting around a star that's causing a whopping up to 22% luminosity drop and the drops occur in an extremely irregular patterns. It's not a star as we'd be able to see it, it's not anything like a blackhole as gravitational lensing (the bending of light caused by things with huge gravitational forces) would give it away. And 'normal' phenomena like those would also have regular periods, not the wacky irregular stuff we're seeing in KIC 8462852. It also has some other quirks like it's not emitting excess infrared energy. The sum of this all is that there is no likely natural cause. And so it's getting people excited because though normal explanations fail to provide plausible explanations, such phenomena could actually be easily explained by advanced technologies such as dyson spheres or even just enormous solar panels quite easily.

So, there is no answer for now. It could be evidence of an advanced alien civilization, it also could be a peculiar natural phenomena. The only way to figure out is more time and research.
